title: Portfolio Website
description: My personal developer portfolio — the site you're on right now! Built with Next.js and Framer Motion to showcase my projects, skills, and experience through smooth animations and a responsive, modern design.

title: Framez (Socialmedia Mobile app)
description: An Instagram-inspired social media mobile app built with React Native, TypeScript, and Expo. Features real-time post feeds, image uploads via Cloudinary, reposts, user profile browsing, Convex Auth authentication, and frosted-glass UI with smooth animations. Built as part of HNG 13 Internship Frontend Track Stage 4.

title: VisualVoiceStatic
description: A static web app that promotes digital inclusivity for users with disabilities, providing accessibility tools including text-to-speech, simplified content views, and sign language support for the deaf community. Hosted via a lightweight Flask/Koyeb server.

title: Aisylum
description: Think refugees and asylum seekers using AI without fear of their info being compromised.

title: Payflow
description: A smart fintech app built for the Wema Hackaholics 6.0 hackathon that transforms digital payments into intelligent, social experiences. Features include AI-powered spending insights via Gemini, transaction tagging, group payment splitting, and cashback via float tracking. Built with React, TailwindCSS, and a FastAPI + Supabase backend.

title: Merry christmas
description: An interactive Christmas greetings webpage with festive animations and holiday-themed visuals, built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

title: globex-website
description: A modern corporate website built with Next.js and Framer Motion animations. Developed as a freelance client project for Globex, featuring sleek section transitions and a professional business landing page layout.

title: HNG Tech Virtual Assistants
description: A TypeScript + React web application serving as a virtual assistants directory or dashboard tool for HNG Tech. Provides an interactive interface for managing and surfacing assistant-related workflows, built with Vite for a fast development experience.

title: Gradzee 🎓
description: An AI-powered graduation planning and admin portal built with Next.js, Supabase, and Gemini API. Designed to help students track their graduation requirements and university administrators manage graduation workflows, with intelligent recommendations and real-time data sync.

title: Audiophile-HNG-13
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform for premium audio products, built with Next.js and Convex for real-time backend. Includes dynamic category pages, a live cart system, SSR-optimised product listing, and responsive design — developed as the HNG 13 Frontend Stage 3A task.

title: Embeddable Tour Webapp
description: A collaborative web app for creating and embedding interactive product tours into any website. Built with Next.js and Supabase, it allows teams to design guided user onboarding flows that can be dropped into external sites as embeddable widgets.

title: Reverse-proxies
description: A hands-on project exploring reverse proxy configuration and networking concepts. Demonstrates how to set up and manage reverse proxies to route HTTP traffic between multiple services — built as part of the HNG 13 Stage 3 DevOps track.

title: React Native Todo App
description: A mobile todo list application built with React Native and Convex for real-time data sync across devices. Features task creation, completion tracking, and persistent storage — developed as the HNG 13 Frontend Stage 3B mobile task.

title: Tick it
description: A task management app implemented in three different frontend frameworks simultaneously — Vue.js, React, and Twig (PHP) — within the same monorepo. Demonstrates framework-agnostic UI design and feature parity, built as an HNG 13 internship challenge.

title: Message50
description: An end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chat app built with React, where messages are encrypted client-side before being transmitted — ensuring not even the server can read them. Paired with a Django REST backend (Msg50-BE) for user management and message relay.

title: C Files
description: A collection of C programs and utility scripts written during CS50 (2021). Covers algorithms, data structures, file I/O, and low-level systems concepts — serving as a foundation in computer science fundamentals.

title: Pic2Plate
description: An AI-powered Next.js app that turns food photos into full recipes. Upload or describe a dish and the Gemini API identifies ingredients and generates step-by-step cooking instructions. Backed by Cloudinary for image handling and Neon (serverless Postgres) for data storage.

title: Msg50-BE
description: Django REST Framework backend powering the Message50 E2EE chat app. Handles user authentication, account management, and acts as a relay server for encrypted messages — never storing plaintext content thanks to client-side encryption.

title: learn-web3
description: A personal learning repository for Web3 development — covering the foundations of Solidity, smart contract design patterns, and on-chain application development on the Ethereum and Cardano ecosystems.

title: Custom Pizza Portal
description: A TypeScript web app for building and ordering custom pizzas online. Users select their crust, sauce, toppings, and size through an intuitive step-by-step configurator, with order summary and pricing calculated dynamically.

title: Liquidramp Dashboard Demo
description: A modern, responsive admin dashboard for Liquidramp, built using React + Vite and styled based on a Figma design. The project emphasizes modularity, performance, and ease of extension.

title: Accessibility-Web-Extension
description: A browser extension that makes the web more inclusive for people with disabilities. Provides screen reader support, content simplification for dyslexia, text-to-ASL sign language conversion via animated avatars, and voice command navigation — all WCAG 2.1 compliant.

title: Portfolio Website V1
description: The first version of my personal developer portfolio, hosted as a GitHub Pages site. Built with React and Bootstrap CSS, showcasing early projects and skills with a clean, responsive layout.

title: VisibleVoice
description: A browser extension that makes online education accessible for users with disabilities. Features include a screen reader for visually impaired users, content simplification and font adjustments for dyslexia, text-to-ASL sign language conversion with animated avatars, and hands-free voice command navigation.

title: Nova frontend
description: Frontend for Nova — an edtech platform built with React. Provides a responsive learning interface for students with course navigation, progress tracking, and an intuitive dashboard designed for an engaging educational experience.

title: Chess
description: A browser-based multiplayer chess game inspired by Chess Titans, allowing two players to compete in real time. Built entirely with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS — featuring full chess rules, piece highlighting, and responsive board layout.

title: DeCirco
description: Revolutionizing recycling by leveraging decentralisation and blockchain technology.

title: Flask Telegram Bot
description: A Telegram chatbot built with Python Flask that responds to messages using GPT-4. Lightweight and webhook-based, it can be deployed on any public server and extended with custom commands or conversation context.

title: MIT Opencourseware Downloader
description: A Python script for bulk downloading video lectures from MIT OpenCourseWare. Automates the process of fetching and saving course materials locally for offline study.

title: Pythonanywhere Free-Tier CICD
description: A CI/CD automation script that uses the PythonAnywhere API to trigger zero-downtime deployments on the free tier — pulling the latest code from GitHub and reloading the web app automatically, without needing paid webhooks or paid hosting features.

title: Ludo-Game
description: A complete web-based implementation of the classic Ludo board game with multiplayer support. Features dice rolling, pawn movement logic, turn management, and win detection — all built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

title: ASL-BE
description: Python Flask backend for an American Sign Language (ASL) recognition application. Built as part of a hackathon, it processes image or video input and returns ASL gesture classifications to power accessibility tools for the deaf community.

title: EcoNauts
description: An environmental awareness web app built for the NACOSS Tech Confluence hackathon. Built with React and TypeScript, EcoNauts encourages eco-friendly habits by gamifying sustainability challenges and tracking users' environmental impact.

title: ProfileCard
description: A sleek, shareable digital business card built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Displays name, role, contact links, and social profiles in a compact card layout — easy to customize and host as a standalone page.

title: NexusMind-AI
description: A React + Vite web application providing an AI-powered virtual customer care assistant interface. Allows businesses to embed an intelligent chatbot that handles customer queries, service lookups, and support escalation.

title: AI-Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A Python implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe with an unbeatable AI opponent powered by the Minimax algorithm. The AI evaluates all possible game states to always play optimally — making it impossible to beat without a draw.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A classic browser-based 2-player Tic-Tac-Toe game built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Features an interactive 3x3 grid, turn-based gameplay, win/draw detection, and a clean UI — playable directly in the browser with no setup needed.

title: Whatsapp-Chatgpt-AI
description: A Flask-based WhatsApp bot that integrates GPT-4 and Gemini API to respond to messages with AI-generated text, generate images on demand, and recognize speech from voice notes — bringing multimodal AI capabilities directly into WhatsApp chats.

title: LearnXcess Frontend
description: The frontend for LearnXcess — an edtech platform connecting students with learning resources and tutors. Built with JavaScript and deployed separately on Vercel for flexible CI/CD, it provides a clean course browsing and enrollment experience.

title: NexusMind
description: A polished marketing landing page for NexusMind — an AI-powered customer intelligence product. Features animated sections, clear value proposition copy, and a modern layout designed to convert visitors to users.

title: Fasanya-Oluwatobiloba/ASO-CONCEPT
description: Contributed backend features to ASO-CONCEPT — a private blogging platform. Built RESTful API endpoints using Node.js and Express, enabling secure blog post management, user authentication, and content delivery for the platform's authors.

title: Openschool Portal
description: Contributed to the Open School Portal — a Next.js school management platform that replaces paper-based workflows with digital attendance, grading, timetables, and fee management. Submitted feature improvements via pull request during the HNG internship collaboration.

title: Andrew-oduola/circle-backend
description: Contributed to Circle — a Django REST Framework backend with JWT authentication via Djoser, custom user models, and Swagger API documentation. Submitted improvements to the user accounts and authentication flow during a hackathon sprint.

title: Chainloop
description: Contributed frontend improvements to Chainloop — a TypeScript + React web application built during a hackathon. Submitted UI enhancements and component fixes via pull request to improve the overall user experience.

title: RefugeeAI
description: Contributed to RefugeeAid — an AI-powered multilingual platform that assists displaced people by coordinating fundraising, distributing supplies, and providing emotional, legal, and integration support. Features offline PWA support, AI-driven need-to-donor matching, predictive resource analytics, and multilingual chat via Google Translate API.
